findings.current: People said that if not for his foul temper, he could become the Sect Leader of a school that very day and build it into a mid-level sect.
findings.defect: The assembled copy omits that the Black Blood Saber was already renowned as a powerful fighter even among the rough world of wandering martial artists. The source and accepted baseline both include this characterization.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly establishes his reputation among wandering martial artists before describing his potential as a sect leader.
findings.replacement: The Black Blood Saber was a renowned powerhouse even among the rough world of wandering martial artists. People said that if not for his foul temper, he could become the Sect Leader of a school that very day and build it into a mid-level sect.

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one source detail omitted compared with both the Korean and the accepted baseline.
